tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/async-runtime.md <<'EOF'
# Async runtime policy

The project's recorded decision on the async runtime is to use tokio. The stated reason is that its ecosystem is mature and stable enough that it was too good to pass up. This is the only decision currently recorded on the async runtime, and nothing supersedes it.
EOF
cat docs/policies/async-runtime.md
